label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

P2P_ACTIVE_ORDER_CAP.note: Most ongoing P2P orders one person may hold as taker; J-p2p-18 holds 19 at once, J-p2p-01 reaches 20.

P2P_BUYER_CANCEL_LIMIT.note: Cancelled orders within the window that pause a person's buying; small, so J-p2p-01 reaches it.

P2P_BUYER_CANCEL_WINDOW_HOURS.note: Hours the cancelled orders are counted over.

P2P_REMIND_WAIT_SECONDS.note: Seconds before the buyer of a paid order may remind the seller, and between reminders; short, so J-p2p-02 reaches it.

P2P_REMIND_MAX.note: Most seller reminders one order may send; small, so a journey can reach the cap.

P2P_EXPORT_MAX_RANGE_DAYS.note: Longest P2P order export, in days, so a journey can see the range cap refuse.

P2P_EXPORT_MAX_ROWS.note: Most rows in one P2P order export.

P2P_PAIR_LIMITS.note: Per-order fiat bounds for the pairs the stack trades, so a journey can see an amount outside them refuse.

P2P_RECEIPT_DAILY_QUOTA.note: P2P receipt downloads per person per UTC day; small, so a journey reaches it.

P2P_RECEIPT_PER_TRADE_QUOTA.note: Downloads of one P2P receipt per person.

P2P_REVIEW_EDIT_WINDOW_SECONDS.note: Seconds the author may edit an order review after leaving it; short, so a journey can see an edit inside it.

P2P_RISK_NOTICE_VERSION.note: P2P risk notice version a taker accepts before the first take. TEST label, not a published notice.

P2P_VERIFICATION_LIMITS.note: Verification-level buy allowances in EUR, the same for every level; small enough for a journey to reach the daily allowance.
